title: Add exact E6 sheared-frame cost census
body:
## Result

Adds a scoped exact negative result for an E6 one-extra rank-one decoder family. Starting from the pinned six-term Gram factorization, the search applies each of the 60 signed elementary transvections `A = I + epsilon E_ij`, then tests the declared 365 projective correction directions and every exact nonzero-lambda breakpoint and complementary interval with fixed dense pairing `B0`.

Across 330,486 support cells, the minimum raw and fully charged root-unit costs are both 37. There are 26 degenerate six-active cells and 330,460 seven-active cells; none of the seven-active cells reaches 35. A least-cost witness is `A=I+E_23`, `a=(1,-1,1,0,0,1)`, `lambda=1/2`, with rank profile `(6,0,6,6,6,6,7)`. This does not establish an unrestricted E6 impossibility, a supplier implementation, or a change to the selected kappa.

## Evidence and replay

The package contains the exact derivation, source pins, per-transvection shards, aggregate certificate, task and overlap metadata, and a stdlib-only rational verifier with identity and rejection controls. Local checks passed: `--smoke`, both shard replays (`164784` and `165702` cells), package metadata/source pins, and `git diff --check`, using Python 3.14.7. Python 3.12 is not installed locally; the registered package workflow is expected to run its declared replay in the repository environment. No CI result is claimed here.

The search stopped at the declared finite family: 60 transvections, 365 directions, exact breakpoints and one rational representative per open interval. It does not cover other six-term factorizations or arbitrary `GL6(Q)` changes. The cost is algebraic root-unit cost only; source, copy, frame, hosting, restoration, precision, interface and supplier costs are not mapped.
